author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅರಿವುಮೂಡುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಮನದಲೇಳುವ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ
ತರತರಹದುತ್ತರವ ಮನವು ಹುಡುಕುವುದು
ಅರಸುವುದೆ ಸಾಧನೆಯು ನೋವುಗಳ ಹಿಂದಿಕ್ಕಿ
ಗರಿಮೆಯದೆ ಸಾಧಕನ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Before understanding dawns, a question rises in the mind;
the mind searches for many kinds of answers;
the searching itself is the achievement, leaving pain behind;
that is the glory of the seeker, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Understanding begins with a question and a search through many answers. The search itself, carried on despite difficulty, is the seeker’s glory.
